Run each sandbox as a smol machine: a real Linux microVM on this host with the workspace mounted like the Docker backend, no container runtime required.

## Distribution

- Package: `@openclaw/smol-sandbox`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@openclaw/smol-sandbox`

## Surface

This plugin declares no channels, providers, commands, or contracts.
